evals.prompt: Turn this 35-second evidence-led explainer storyboard into an executable edit direction. Search our reusable editing patterns if available. The visual language should feel tactile and precise, but the story must stay readable.
evals.expected_output: Retrieves complete editing elements from the canonical corpus.; Selects a coherent subset with explicit decisions.; Produces one timed ordered recipe and renderer proof handoff.; Keeps readability and restraint ahead of effect density.
assertions: Treats Resource Bank editing elements as the reusable creative-pattern corpus and preserves provenance, golden example, and golden recipe for selected patterns.
Marks candidates use, adapt, reject, or block and explains compatibility rather than stacking every available effect.
Selects one timing master and emits frame- or time-addressed operations with parameters, dependencies, owners, and acceptance checks.
Routes deterministic implementation and rendered frame/range proof to the renderer instead of claiming the advisory packet is final output.

farplane.title: Compiles reusable Vox-style patterns into a restrained edit recipe

evals.prompt: Our Brand Kit approves calm captions and restrained orange registration. The inspiration pack contains aggressive word-by-word captions, whip transitions, and a useful paper-layer cadence. Advise the edit and prepare the implementation handoff.
evals.expected_output: Treats Brand Kit policy as authoritative without turning it into the global corpus.; Decides every inspiration pattern explicitly.; Adapts compatible cadence and rejects conflicting caption/transition behavior.; Emits an executable renderer handoff.
assertions: Treats the Brand Kit as an approved snapshot/policy layer and not a replacement creative-pattern corpus.
Applies Brand Kit policy to adapt or reject conflicting editing elements rather than silently blending them.
Preserves complete realization fields for any selected inspiration pattern.
Produces a timed recipe with caption, motion, transition, and proof details sufficient for the named renderer.

farplane.title: Keeps Brand Kit policy separate from the creative-pattern corpus

evals.prompt: The cut currently feels dead. Add movement to the evidence card while it is on screen, then move from the card to a human consequence shot. The editor suggested using a transition on every animation.
evals.expected_output: Separates within-state motion from between-state transition.; Gives each operation a story purpose and timing.; Rejects transition spam.; Names observable checks.
assertions: Classifies movement within the evidence-card state as motion and the card-to-human state change as a transition.
Names the viewer-state purpose, target layer, timing, parameters, and restraint rule for each operation.
Rejects decorative transitions for animations that do not cross scene or state boundaries.
Includes frame/range acceptance checks for both the motion and the actual transition.

evals.prompt: Use the editing element called Exact State Handoffs in our next reel. I only copied its title and one-line description into this message. Send the plan straight to Remotion.
evals.expected_output: Attempts authoritative retrieval when available.; Refuses to invent missing pattern details.; Emits a precise blocker when example or recipe remains unresolved.; Does not unlock Remotion prematurely.
assertions: Retrieves the authoritative Resource Bank record when the adapter is available rather than relying on the title-only packet.
Requires provenance, description, whyItWorks, goldenExample, and goldenRecipe before selecting the pattern.
Marks the pattern block when its golden example or recipe cannot be resolved and states the exact missing input/runtime.
Does not produce a ready renderer handoff from guessed or remembered recipe details.

evals.prompt: Create the edit recipe for a vertical reel with voiceover, three SFX hits, two source photos that still need clean cutouts, kinetic captions, and a model-generated bridge clip. Final assembly is in Remotion.
evals.expected_output: Maintains one timing basis.; Routes media preparation, audio, model-native video, and deterministic rendering to their owners.; Compiles dependencies into an ordered recipe.; Blocks final readiness on accepted inputs and observable render proof.
assertions: Uses the measured voiceover or its cue sheet as the single timing master and aligns edit steps to it.
Returns photo cleanup, SFX or mix, and bridge-clip media dependencies to Asset Advisor, which selects any Audio Advisor or AI Video Advisor child route; deterministic assembly remains with Remotion.
Orders edit steps around those dependencies and names files or exact missing-file blockers.
Requires caption readability, layer/composite checks, transition range checks, and final render proof before readiness.
